scope: Proposition 4.3 (Positive replacement of the Hamiltonian) of the manuscript “A two-dimensional area law from a global spectral gap” (preprints/A-two-dimensional-area-law-from-a-global-spectral-gap-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 265 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 91e272a2245ad0bd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose HΩ = E0Ω, ∥Ω∥ = 1, and H − E0I ≥ ∆(I − PΩ), PΩ = |Ω⟩⟨Ω|. For each integer p ≥ 1 and α = p/(p + 1), there are operators ki, indexed by the original supports and retaining their anchors, and a constant c∗ > 0 such that 0 ≤ ki ≤ I, kiΩ = 0, HF := ∑︂ i∈I ki ≥ c−1 ∗ (H − E0I) ≥ g(I − PΩ), g := ∆/c∗. (4.8) Thus HF has the unique ground vector Ω, ground energy zero, and gap at least g. Furthermore, ki,l := Ei,l(ki) ∈ [0, I], ∥ki − ki,l∥ ≤ Ce−clα (l ∈ Z≥0). (4.9) Each ki is supported in the connected component containing ai.
